trial_title: Study of the Cellular Diffusion of Tacrolimus Across the Membrane of Mononuclear Cells
brief_summary:
Pharmacokinetics of tacrolimus are highly variable and may result in graft rejection (underdosing) or toxicity (overdosing).

The risk of transplant rejection and the toxicity of tacrolimus can be reduced by pharmacological therapeutic monitoring of the molecule, based on the measurement of residual blood concentrations. Nevertheless, some patients are victims of rejections or toxic signs even though their blood concentrations are in the therapeutic target.

eligibility_table.criterion: phlebotomy as part of the maintenance treatment of hemochromatosis
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has hemochromatosis and phlebotomy is a standard treatment for this condition.

eligibility_table.criterion: having received the information on the protocol and not having indicated his opposition to participate
eligibility_table.justification: There is no indication that the patient has opposed participation, and he has received information about the protocol.
The patient is not receiving any immunosuppressive therapy, which meets the inclusion criterion.

eligibility_table.criterion: not receiving drug treatment that can induce or inhibit the protein ABCB1 (Rifampicin, Carbamazepine, Phenobarbital, Phenytoin, Efavirenz, Amiodarone, azole antifungals, calcium channel blockers)
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is not on any medications that are known to induce or inhibit the ABCB1 protein.

eligibility_table.criterion: participation in another protocol whose procedures are incompatible with the realization of the study
eligibility_table.justification: There is no information provided about participation in other protocols, so it cannot be determined.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Is the patient currently participating in any other clinical trial that involves procedures incompatible with the study of tacrolimus diffusion?

eligibility_table.criterion: adults who are subject to legal protection (protection of justice, guardianship) and persons deprived of their liberty
eligibility_table.justification: There is no indication that the patient is under legal protection or deprived of liberty.
The patient is male and there is no indication of pregnancy.
